ICS 65.150TXD 18New Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard (Part 14) specifies guidelines for construction of 325 m purse seine.2. ReferencesThe following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject torevision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibilityof applying the most recent editions of these standards indicated below.4401 : 2006 Textiles - Twisted nylon fishnet twines (fourth revision)5508 (Part 1) : 2020 Guide for fishing gear - General (first revision)6347 : 2003 Textile - Polyethylene monofilament twines for fishing - Specification (first revision)7533 : 2003 Textiles - Polyamide (nylon) monofilament yarn for fishing - Specification (second revision)
